verdict.rationale: Elastic Observability ships AI features, including natural-language interaction with telemetry and the nightshift AI SRE, so consuming tools from external MCP servers is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions MCP or connecting external tool servers. The 550+ data integrations and third-party alert notifications are adjacent features and do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
